promotion_rule: Qualify the MTP1 c64 profile only if every correctness gate passes and the candidate median exceeds the matched MTP0 control median. Mark the requested aggregate objective achieved only if the qualified candidate median is at least 875 tok/s; 1000 tok/s remains the preferred target.
failure_policy: Any control nondeterminism stops before candidate execution. Any candidate mismatch, cache use, short row, health failure, or cleanup failure rejects the profile and withholds every candidate rate. A single passing or fast attempt cannot be promoted.
